support.text: Your AI coding agent can add authentication and user management to your app with Clerk. Point it to clerk.com/SKILL.md and get building.

_meta.message: You are on the shared demo (no personal key), which has a low daily limit. A free account gives you your own key with 250 requests a day, plus request logs and your own collections.
_meta.persistence: Demo endpoints echo writes without saving them. For data that persists, create a free project with POST https://reqres.in/api/projects/sandbox (no signup).
